_comment: Schools a school-zone polygon names that the school standard data does not contain, although the Schoolinfo API does. The standard data is the only source of `school_id`, so the school cannot enter `school_master` and its apartments get no serving row. Each entry is a reviewed upstream defect, not a matcher bug: the label matched, the school simply does not exist in the identity source. The audit excludes only these labels from `named assignments without school link` and counts them separately, so any new unmatched label still fails. Remove an entry once the source republishes and the school appears.
